topic: Dashboard data set implementation on mall analytics
summary_markdown:
The conversation addressed a bug where the dashboard URL parameters were incorrectly displaying January dates instead of the specified date range (September 1st to September 7th) for mall analytics. One participant confirmed that this issue had been fixed and would be deployed to production in the next release.

Additionally, there was a discussion about restoring the ability to set data sets using URL parameters within the Mall Analytics UI. The consensus was reached that while the functionality should not be exposed to clients via the main UI, it must correctly pull all available data set information from the URL for internal use.
decisions: The dashboard bug regarding incorrect date display in URLs is fixed and scheduled for the next production release.
Data set retrieval from URL parameters has been restored for Mall Analytics.
